description.name: Silvery Lightning
description.text: Three single attacks (3.10 each), restores HP (17.5/20/25) if 0-2/3-4/4+ allies have any Attach Lightning

description.name: Lightning Quick Cast 4

description.name: Attach Lightning
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Lightning damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Lightning resistance +20%

description.name: Staunch Sister Mode
description.text: Casts Precocious Gift after using Silvery Lightning or Mysidian Heal, removed after triggering four times

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
